description: FULL FDA DRUG LABEL TEXT from the current DailyMed Structured Product Label — indications, dosage and administration, contraindications, warnings and precautions, boxed warning, adverse reactions, and every other labeled section, as readable plain text. Pass a DRUG NAME ("Ozempic", "ibuprofen") and it resolves the label automatically, or a DailyMed set_id. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "what are the warnings for X", "what is X indicated for", "what is the dose of X", "does X have a boxed warning". Returns the label title, labeler, SPL version and publication date alongside the sections.

drug_name.description: Drug brand or generic name (e.g. "Ozempic", "ibuprofen"). Resolved to the primary manufacturer's label. Use this OR set_id.

max_section_chars.description: Truncate each section body to this many characters (default 4000, max 40000).

section.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter, matched against both the section heading and its LOINC category, e.g. "boxed warning", "warnings", "dosage", "indications". Omit for the whole label.

set_id.description: DailyMed SET ID UUID, when you already have one. Takes precedence over drug_name.

name: get_drug

outputSchema.description: Full Structured Product Label with metadata and sections

sections.description: SPL sections (dosage, warnings, adverse reactions, etc.)

content.description: Section content HTML or plain text

title: Get Drug
